name: Twister System
summary: A source-based reading guide to Eddie Bravo’s announced Twister and truck-entry material from back and side-control contexts.
description: Compare two official episode descriptions before choosing a Twister or truck study question.
overview: The inspected announcements emphasize different starting contexts. Episode 85 describes Twister work from the back and side-control scrambles; episode 99 describes twister side control with back-taking and truck-entry material. These descriptions support choosing a topic, not reconstructing the movements.

guide.display_title: Twister and Truck: Choosing an Entry Study

fits: You want to separate Twister study from the question of how the truck is entered.
consider_alternative_if: If your immediate interest is positional movement from twister side control, start with the episode 99 announcement rather than episode 85’s Twister-focused description.

includes: Episode 85 advertises Twister work from back and side-control scramble contexts, including paths to the truck.
Episode 99 names a back take and a truck entry from twister side control.
limits: The selected sources are episode announcements, with no step-by-step execution or competition-rules treatment.

start_here.title: Compare the announced starting contexts
start_here.task: Read the two short official announcements. Put back-position and scramble questions under episode 85, and twister-side-control entry questions under episode 99. Select the description closest to your current problem; do not fill in a lockdown-to-truck sequence that neither announcement explains.
start_here.section: MTS episode 85 “Killa B part 3”; MTS episode 99 “Twister Side Control”.

sources.title: MTS episode 85 “Killa B part 3” by Eddie Bravo
sources.note: Read Bravo’s official episode announcement. It identifies Twister material from the back and side-control scrambles and paths to the truck; it does not provide the episode’s technical demonstrations.

sources.title: MTS episode 99 “Twister Side Control” is now LIVE! by Eddie Bravo
sources.note: Read Bravo’s official announcement naming twister-side-control material, a back take and a truck entry. These are advertised episode topics, not inspected video instruction.
